layers.name: Charger Siting Priority
layers.citation: Siting priority 0-100 per Rebana kecamatan = 0.5 x need (mean of normalised population-weighted travel time to nearest charger and distance to charger) + 0.25 x demand (normalised log population) + 0.25 x grid readiness (normalised substation headroom). Inputs: analysis/rebana_data.json (rk)

layers.name: Rebana KPI Kecamatan

layers.name: Population Beyond 30 min
layers.citation: Access gap: residents (Kontur 2023) of villages whose nearest public charger is more than 30 min by car or unreachable within 60 min; NoData = village within 30 min. ttm/ttm.json

layers.name: Coverage Model Picks
layers.citation: Greedy 10-km coverage model: the next kecamatan centroids that add the most Rebana residents within 10 km of a charger (baseline share 67%); value = residents newly covered. analysis/rebana_build.py

layers.name: Transformer Overload Share
layers.citation: Share of measured distribution transformers loaded above 100% per H3 res-7 hexagon (~5 km2), PLN UP3 Indramayu register (1638 transformers); aggregated, no transformer identities
